name: ur cutter prowess

winrate_basis.why: no head-to-head winrate exists for Modern in any source this repo can reach: statistics_matchups returns zero rows for the format and archetype, statistics_archetypes carries no winrate field, and this run's own fingerprint records winrate_vs_field as an empty map. Recording a number here would be inventing one.

opponent_gameplan: Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear behind Mishra's Bauble and Lava Dart, with Cori-Steel Cutter turning every cheap spell into a body and Slickshot Show-Off plus Mutagenic Growth closing from six or more life.

opponent_plan.posture_why: Every card is one mana or free, so they are attacking on turn two and using Mutagenic Growth to push the last points through a blocker rather than trading with it.

key_cards.why: a one-mana artifact that makes a Monk and equips itself every turn they cast two spells; removal on the creature does nothing.
three copies at one mana, and Cori-Steel Cutter's trigger and our own colorless artifacts are both in range.
our Psychic Frog, Orcish Bowmasters and Counterspell are all mana value two.
delirium is trivial for them, and six damage answers every creature we play.

primary_gameplan: Fatal Push on Dragon's Rage Channeler before it is delirious, Orcish Bowmasters on the Monk, and Toxic Deluge only once Cori-Steel Cutter has made more than one body. Psychic Frog blocks profitably and grows out of Lava Dart range.
pitfalls: Lava Dart's flashback kills Orcish Bowmasters and Tamiyo for free, so neither is a safe block.
Slickshot Show-Off plus Mutagenic Growth is eight damage from an empty board; stop counting their hand as blanks at four life.
Mystical Dispute costs three against a deck whose only blue cards are Expressive Iteration and Preordain, so it is here for the counter war, not the threats.
stance_rationale: Cori-Steel Cutter makes a Monk every time they cast their second spell, and Slickshot Show-Off ends games out of nowhere. One-for-one removal loses to the token half, so Toxic Deluge comes in - and it kills our own board with theirs.

opposing_sideboard_in.why: one mana against triggered abilities and colorless spells - our Engineered Explosives and Nihil Spellbomb both die to it.
counters the entire two-drop half of our deck for one mana.
one mana, six damage with delirium, which their Baubles and Lava Darts turn on by turn two.
free, and it strips the one card we are digging toward once a fetch has put something in our graveyard.

play_plan.keep: Two lands and two pieces of one-mana removal; counters alone lose to Cori-Steel Cutter.
play_plan.goldfish_for: Toxic Deluge, held until Cori-Steel Cutter has made a second Monk.
play_plan.watch_for: Untapped red mana at four or fewer life is Slickshot Show-Off plus Mutagenic Growth.
play_plan.posture_why: Their clock beats ours, so the Cutter has to be answered before we attack.

self_cost: Toxic Deluge for one or two takes Psychic Frog and Orcish Bowmasters along with their Monks and Dragon's Rage Channeler; Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student is a 0/3 and survives both numbers as a 0/2 or a 0/1. Against a deck that rebuilds off one Cutter trigger, losing Frog and Bowmasters is still a real cost.
